items.title: Industrial Foundations
items.description: Execution of foundations for industrial structures according to project specifications.
items.details: We execute industrial foundations with a focus on strength, stability, and technical precision. We develop solutions according to soil characteristics and the needs of each project, guaranteeing a safe and reliable base for your construction.

items.title: Earthworks
items.description: Demolition and earthmoving with planning and execution control.
items.details: We provide earthworks services, including site preparation, land leveling, excavation, filling, and soil movement. Through careful planning and the use of appropriate equipment, we ensure ideal site conditions, efficient use of space, and safety throughout every stage of the project.

items.title: Industrial Warehouses
items.description: Metal structures built according to structural engineering designs.
items.details: We develop solutions for the construction and assembly of industrial warehouses, following structural engineering specifications. Our goal is to deliver durable, strong, and functional structures tailored to each operation, considering space optimization, long-term performance, and construction efficiency.

items.title: Overhead Crane Installation
items.description: Installation of overhead cranes with efficiency and reliability.
items.details: We carry out overhead crane installation and assembly, taking into account the technical, structural, and operational requirements of each industrial environment. We prioritize proper alignment, safety, and system reliability, contributing to the efficient handling and movement of loads and materials.

items.title: Structural Projects
items.description: Structural projects according to technical standards and specifications of each work.
items.details: We develop structural solutions considering the characteristics and needs of each project. The projects are developed with attention to safety, functionality, dimensioning and compliance with applicable technical standards, seeking to optimize materials and ensure constructive efficiency.

items.title: Electrical, hydraulic and fire protection system installations
items.description: Electrical, hydraulic and fire protection system installations with quality and safety.
items.details: We carry out electrical and hydraulic installations for industrial and commercial environments, following the technical requirements of each project. We work to ensure functionality, organization, safety and efficiency of the systems, from infrastructure to the execution of the installations.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: JAMA Fundações respects the privacy of website visitors and is committed to protecting personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

sections.title: 1. Information Collection
sections.text: We only collect information voluntarily provided by users through contact forms, quotation requests, and other communication channels available on our website.

sections.title: 2. Use of Information
sections.text: The collected information is used exclusively to respond to inquiries, provide information about our services, prepare quotations, and maintain communication with clients and partners.

sections.title: 3. Data Sharing
sections.text: JAMA Fundações does not sell or share personal data with third parties, except when required by law or authorized by the data subject.

sections.title: 4. Information Security
sections.text: We adopt technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, or improper disclosure.

sections.title: 5. Your Rights
sections.text: Data subjects may request access, correction, updating, or deletion of their personal data, in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

sections.title: 6. Contact
sections.text: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or the processing of your personal data, please contact JAMA Fundações through our official communication channels.
